```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE nested class-student analysis in R
##
## Input:
##   ../data/07_designTable.csv
##   ../data/07_EEGdata_long.csv
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ ConditionCode +
##     (1 | Class) +
##     (1 | Class:Student)
##
## Permutation:
##   Condition labels are permuted within each student
##   nested within class.
##
## EEG data itself is never permuted.
## Only condition labels are permuted.
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(progressr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE nested class-student analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load EEG long-format data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read.csv("../data/07_designTable.csv")

EEGlong <- read.csv("../data/07_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Prepare data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- designTable %>%
  mutate(RowID = row_number())

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = c("Class", "Student", "ConditionCode")) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = factor(Class),
    Student = factor(Student),
    Channel = factor(Channel),
    ConditionCode = as.numeric(ConditionCode),
    Time = as.numeric(Time),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude)
  )

channels <- unique(dat$Channel)
times <- sort(unique(dat$Time))

nChan  <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

cat("Number of channels:", nChan , "\n")

cat("Number of time points:", nTime, "\n")

## ==========================================================
## Basic checks
## ==========================================================

units <- designTable %>%
  distinct(Class, Student)


for (u in seq_len(nrow(units))) {
  current_class <- units$Class[u]
  current_student <- units$Student[u]
  
  tmp <- designTable %>%
    filter(Class == current_class, Student == current_student)
  
  if (nrow(tmp) != 2) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Each student must have exactly two rows. ",
        "Problematic unit: Class ",
        current_class,
        ", Student ",
        current_student
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (!all(sort(tmp$ConditionCode) == c(-1, 1))) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Each student must have one Control condition (-1) ",
        "and one Treatment condition (1). ",
        "Problematic unit: Class ",
        current_class,
        ", Student ",
        current_student
      )
    )
  }
}

if (any(is.na(dat$RowID))) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Some EEG rows could not be matched to designTable. ",
      "Check Class, Student, and ConditionCode."
    )
  )
}

cat("Basic design checks completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function to compute the LME t-map
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      fit <- lmer(Amplitude ~ ConditionCode +
                    (1 | Class) +
                    (1 | Class:Student), data = .x)
      
      cf <- coef(summary(fit))
      
      tibble(t_Cond = cf["ConditionCode", "t value"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  t_values <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_Cond)
  
  matrix(
    t_values,
    nrow = nChan ,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmap(dat)

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_Obs <- tfce_transform(t_Obs, E = 0.66, H = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 999

TFCE_permMax <- rep(NaN, n_perm)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.1. Prepare the observed long-format dataset once
## ------------------------------------------------------------

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(
    designTable,
    by = c("Class", "Student", "ConditionCode")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = factor(Class),
    Student = factor(Student),
    Channel = factor(Channel),
    ConditionCode = as.numeric(ConditionCode),
    Time = as.numeric(Time),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude)
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.2. Set up parallel processing
## ------------------------------------------------------------

n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

plan(
  multisession,
  workers = n_workers
)

handlers("txtprogressbar")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.3 Parallel permutation test
## ------------------------------------------------------------


with_progress({
  progress_update <- progressor(along = seq_len(n_perm))
  
  TFCE_permMax <- future_sapply(seq_len(n_perm),
                                function(p) {
                                  perm_cond <- designTable %>%
                                    distinct(RowID, Class, Student, ConditionCode) %>%
                                    group_by(Class, Student) %>%
                                    mutate(ConditionCode_perm = sample(ConditionCode)) %>%
                                    ungroup() %>%
                                    select(RowID,
                                           ConditionCode = ConditionCode_perm)
                                  
                                  perm_dat <- dat %>%
                                    select(-ConditionCode) %>%
                                    left_join(perm_cond, by = "RowID") %>%
                                    mutate(
                                      Class = factor(Class),
                                      Student = factor(Student),
                                      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
                                      ConditionCode = as.numeric(ConditionCode),
                                      Time = as.numeric(Time),
                                      Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude)
                                    )
                                  
                                  t_perm <- compute_tmap(perm_dat)
                                  
                                  TFCE_perm <- tfce_transform(t_perm,
                                                              E = 0.66,
                                                              H = 2,
                                                              dh = 0.1)
                                  
                                  perm_max <- max(abs(TFCE_perm),
                                                  na.rm = TRUE)
                                  
                                  progress_update()
                                  
                                  perm_max
                                },
                                future.seed = TRUE,
                                future.packages = "dplyr")
})
# Return to normal single-session execution
plan(sequential)

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

## ==========================================================
## Include the observed assignment in the maximum-TFCE
## distribution.
## ==========================================================

maxTFCE <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax, max(abs(TFCE_Obs), na.rm = TRUE)))

critical_index <- round((n_perm + 1) * (1 - alpha))

maxTFCEcrit <- maxTFCE[critical_index]

Mask <- abs(TFCE_Obs) >= maxTFCEcrit

## ==========================================================
## Compute family-wise-error-corrected p-values
## ==========================================================

compute_p_values <- function(TFCE_Obs, TFCE_permMax) {
  P <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(TFCE_Obs),
    ncol = ncol(TFCE_Obs),
    dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs)
  )
  
  for (ch in seq_len(nrow(TFCE_Obs))) {
    for (tp in seq_len(ncol(TFCE_Obs))) {
      P[ch, tp] <- (sum(TFCE_permMax >=
                          abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, tp]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (length(TFCE_permMax) + 1)
    }
  }
  
  P
}

P_Values <- compute_p_values(TFCE_Obs, TFCE_permMax)

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")

cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit))

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(
  tObs         = t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs     = TFCE_Obs,
  TFCE_Null    = TFCE_permMax,
  maxTFCEcrit  = maxTFCEcrit,
  P_Values     = P_Values,
  Mask         = Mask,
  alpha        = alpha,
  nPerm        = n_perm,
  model = paste0("Amplitude ~ ConditionCode + ", "(1 | Class) + ", "(1 | Class:Student)"),
  permutation = paste0(
    "Condition labels permuted within each ",
    "student nested within class"
  )
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Save TFCE results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../Results")) {
  dir.create("../Results")
}

save(
  Results,
  times,
  nChan,
  channels,
  file = paste0("../Results/", "07_TFCE_nested_class_student_results.RData")
)

cat(paste0(
  "TFCE nested class-student analysis completed ",
  "and results saved.\n"
))

```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
rm(list = ls())
load("../Results/07_TFCE_nested_class_student_results.RData")
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")

## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot functions
## ==========================================================

mT <- Results$tObs
mT[!Results$Mask] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT, "TFCE-corrected Group Effect", times, nChan, channels)

## ==========================================================
## Step 8: Plot observed TFCE values
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_Obs, "Observed TFCE Map", times, nChan, channels)
```
